_note: Twelve made-up people with real-looking schedules. 'Try the sample group' picks a random subset the size of the group the user asked for, so the demo is different each time rather than always the same five.

travelers.name: Maya
travelers.must_have: Somewhere warm. I have been in New England all year.

travelers.name: Josh
travelers.must_have: I want to be somewhere with a real night scene, not a resort.

travelers.name: Priya
travelers.must_have: At least one serious hike or something to actually see.

travelers.name: Dev
travelers.must_have: Good food matters more to me than anything else here.

travelers.name: Ana
travelers.must_have: I am the broke one here. Please do not pick a $3000 trip.

travelers.name: Theo
travelers.must_have: Museums and long lunches. I do not need to be out past eleven.

travelers.name: Lena
travelers.must_have: Give me somewhere I can photograph. Light matters more than luxury.

travelers.name: Omar
travelers.must_have: I have been inside a hospital all year. Somewhere quiet and warm.

travelers.name: Noor
travelers.must_have: I travel for work constantly, so this one should feel like a treat.

travelers.name: Gabe
travelers.must_have: I cook for a living. I want somebody else to cook for me.

travelers.name: Ruth
travelers.must_have: Gentle walking, good views, and nowhere I need to shout to be heard.

travelers.name: Kai
travelers.must_have: Cheap and loud. I am on tour the rest of the year.
